as_told.title: Leaked Kit Green / Kit Randall May phone call about testing experiencers and 'hybrids'

plain: A man who presents himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, refers on a podcast to a leaked phone call between a man named Kit Green and a person named Kay Randall May. According to Brown, the call was about contactees, people who say they have been in touch with non-human beings. If real, the call would show insiders privately discussing such people.
